clue.text: Customs demand that objects d'art be displayed therein

definitions.text: Customs demand that objects d'art be displayed therein

parts.words: Customs demand that objects d'art be displayed therein
parts.note: read as a customs officer telling a traveller to open and display a piece of luggage, it describes a glass cabinet in a museum

explanation.surface: Customs officers insist that a traveller's art treasures be put on show.
explanation.walkthrough: Customs officers ask you to 'show (your) case'; a museum's glass cabinet is where art objects are displayed.
explanation.definitionFit: A glazed display cabinet in which valuable items are exhibited to visitors.

clue.text: Rock salt-it's healthy to consume it

indicators.note: to consume something is to take it inside, so one word swallows the other

parts.note: hale means healthy, as in 'hale and hearty'
taken as written

explanation.surface: A claim that eating rock salt is good for you.
explanation.definitionFit: The mineral form of sodium chloride, the natural stone mined for table salt.

clue.text: Western liturgy is put down in a book

parts.note: a rite is a liturgy, a form of religious service

explanation.surface: The Western church's order of service is recorded in a volume.
explanation.definitionFit: To record words on paper, as an author does in a volume.

clue.text: Not a bad lot!

parts.note: reads as praise for a decent group of people, but means quite a large number of things

explanation.definitionFit: A considerable quantity; a 'lot' that is far from small.

clue.text: Old mare transported from noble estate

indicators.note: carried off to a new arrangement, so the letters of the two words are shuffled

explanation.surface: An old horse is taken away from an aristocrat's lands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transported' rearranges OLD MARE into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The territory or rank held by a count, a peer of the British nobility.

clue.text: To make charges isa County Council practice

parts.note: the paper prints 'is a' run together; 'is' links and 'a' gives the letter
CC is the abbreviation for County Council, a British local authority
use means custom or practice, as in 'usage'

explanation.surface: Levying fees is something the local council habitually does.
explanation.walkthrough: A County Council is a British local government body.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring an allegation against someone; to blame formally.

clue.text: I'll say it's a church feature

indicators.note: say signals that the words are spoken, so the sound counts rather than the spelling

parts.note: I'll, spoken, matches the pronunciation of the church passage

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims enthusiastically about something in a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I'll say!' looks like an exclamation of agreement; instead 'say' tells you to pronounce I'LL.
explanation.definitionFit: The passage between pews down which a bride walks.

clue.text: Worthless scoundrel followed and cut down

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog, hence a contemptible man
tailed means shadowed or followed

explanation.surface: A villain was shadowed and then reduced in stature.
explanation.definitionFit: Reduced or shortened, as a programme is truncated.

clue.text: Stand in the brewery at a time of inactivity

parts.note: still describes motionless inactivity
an age is a period or time

explanation.surface: A brewery stand used during a quiet spell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' joins the two pieces: an age (a time) of stillness.
explanation.definitionFit: A frame or platform on which casks of beer rest in a cellar.

clue.text: Vestment with popular appeal to a white man

parts.note: an alb is a white vestment worn by priests
in means fashionable or popular
O is the vocative appeal, as in 'O Lord'

explanation.surface: A priest's robe with mass appeal to a pale man.
explanation.walkthrough: O as an appeal or invocation is an old crossword convention.
explanation.definitionFit: A person lacking skin pigment, whose hair and skin are pale.

clue.text: Use a filter once more to check

explanation.surface: Refiltering something to curb it.
explanation.definitionFit: Strain again, read as re-strain; also to hold back or curb someone.

clue.text: Came after the finish of a motor-cycle race

parts.note: the TT, the Tourist Trophy, is the Isle of Man motorcycle race
a race that is over has ended

explanation.surface: Someone arrived once the bike race had finished.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'after the finish of a motor-cycle race' as 'a TT ended'. The TT is a famous motorcycle race on the Isle of Man.
explanation.definitionFit: Was present at, as one goes to an event.

clue.text: Authorise English to arrest the French

parts.note: nab is slang for arrest
le is French for 'the'

explanation.surface: Permission is given for English police to detain the French.
explanation.definitionFit: Empower; give someone the means or permission to act.

clue.text: The likely subject of old record in dispensary

definitions.text: The likely subject of old record in dispensary

indicators.note: in places the old record inside the word for a dispensary

parts.note: a pharmacy dispenses medicines
a log is a written record

explanation.surface: Archive records in a chemist's shop would likely concern drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue describes the answer: the science of drugs is what a dispensary's records would cover.
explanation.definitionFit: The study of drugs and their effects, central to a chemist's trade.

clue.text: Collection of stamps taken from a Greek letter recently

parts.note: phi is the 21st letter of the Greek alphabet
lately means recently

explanation.surface: Stamps recently removed from a letter from Greece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a Greek letter' suggests a posted letter, fitting stamps; it is the alphabet letter PHI.
explanation.definitionFit: The hobby of stamp collecting.

clue.text: Perplexing clue read quietly and solved

indicators.note: something perplexing is muddled, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: p (piano) means quietly in music

explanation.surface: A baffling crossword clue read softly and then cracked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perplexing' rearranges CLUE READ into CLEAREDU; the surface about a puzzling clue being cracked is apt.
explanation.definitionFit: Explained or resolved, as a mystery is cleared up.

clue.text: Fellow and I get boat built in Canada

parts.note: a man is a fellow

indicators.note: built suggests constructing anew, so the letters are put together in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A man and I construct a boat in Canada.
explanation.walkthrough: 'built' rearranges BOAT into TOBA. 'in Canada' defines a place in Canada.
explanation.definitionFit: A prairie province located in that country.

clue.text: Firm, fine lady becomes relatively popular!

indicators.note: becomes signals the letters change into something else

explanation.surface: A firm, refined woman grows popular.
explanation.walkthrough: 'becomes' rearranges FIRM FINE LADY. The definition is cryptic: someone liked by one's relatives.
explanation.definitionFit: A person close to and liked by one's whole household.

clue.text: Lack of communication from emergency troops

definitions.meaning: soldiers held back for use when needed

explanation.surface: Back-up soldiers who say little.
explanation.definitionFit: Reticence or aloofness; also forces kept back for emergencies.

clue.text: The devils keep doctor immersed in studies

indicators.note: immersed in places the doctor inside the word for studies

parts.note: dens are studies, private rooms for work
MO is a medical officer, a doctor

explanation.surface: Devils keep a doctor engrossed in his reading.
explanation.definitionFit: Evil spirits or fiends.

clue.text: Half-a dozen vehicles provided for ministers

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals
cars are vehicles

explanation.surface: Six cars are laid on for government ministers.
explanation.definitionFit: Parish clergy are ministers of religion.

clue.text: In the past Ernest appeared unyielding

indicators.note: In tells you to look within the following words for a continuous run of letters

explanation.surface: Ernest used to look severe.
explanation.definitionFit: Strict and severe, unbending.

clue.text: Sunday excursionist who gets out of gear

parts.note: a tripper is a day-tripper or excursionist

explanation.surface: A Sunday day-tripper who escapes from the car's gears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets out of gear' suggests machinery; it means takes off clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A performer who undresses, removing clothing for an audience.

clue.text: Calm sports master

parts.note: PE is physical education, school sports
an ace is an expert or master

explanation.surface: A composed games teacher.
explanation.definitionFit: Tranquillity; quiet stillness.

clue.text: Predecessor rent robe in terror

indicators.note: in places the shuffled garment inside the word for terror

parts.note: fear is terror

indicators.note: rent means torn apart, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An ancestor tears his robe in a panic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rent' (torn) rearranges ROBE into OREB; 'in' puts that inside FEAR. 'rent' poses as money paid for housing.
explanation.definitionFit: An ancestor, someone who came before.

clue.text: Faculty head is about to act. Quite right!

indicators.note: is about means surrounds, so one word goes round the other

parts.note: a dean heads a university faculty
do means to act or perform

explanation.surface: The dean is about to take action, and rightly so.
explanation.definitionFit: Exactly correct, precisely accurate.

clue.text: Is able to go to that ravine

parts.note: can means is able
yon is an old word for that, as in 'yonder'

explanation.surface: Someone can visit that gorge.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep gorge, usually with a river.

clue.text: Declare love for strong coffee

parts.note: express means declare or state
O is love, zero in tennis

explanation.surface: Confessing a passion for strong coffee.
explanation.definitionFit: A variant spelling of espresso, coffee forced through under steam pressure.
